arms.note: two scratch trees made in one second hold the same files and so the same commits, and a memo keyed by a commit is shared between them

arms.name: M-LAND-REPO-SHARES-BASE
arms.note: two scratch repositories made in one second hold the same files and so the same commits

arms.name: M-SLICE-GATE-TREE-SHARES-BASE

arms.name: M-TOLERANT-HONESTY-BLIND
arms.note: a path spelled whole in a literal is not seen, so a test that reads one of the tolerated paths goes unnoticed

arms.name: M-TOLERANT-HONESTY-LEDGER-BLIND
